name: Anticipation, overshoot, follow-through
summary: Give cards and UI a wind-up, a measured overshoot and a settle, with children that lag behind.
qualityBar: Anticipation 3-8 frames, overshoot 8-15 percent, settle 12-20 frames after release for every recipe (measured by test.mjs)
Measured overshoot within 0.6 points and pull-back within 0.3 points of the recipe; settle within 1.5 frames
Speed is continuous where the pull-back hands over to the spring; card ends exactly on target
Children lag more than 3 px while the parent moves and catch up at rest; tilt capped at 0.12 rad
Demo: flat vs alive card on the same three hops; QC passes, no frozen run over 0.5 s
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (61 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, 1080x1920, silent; engine QC on the card and the mp4 passed, 2 warnings). I viewed out/contact.png and judged it good (cards are small in the window; the difference reads but is subtle in stills). NOT checked: the motion was judged from stills, the contact sheet and numbers, not played back by a person; no audio; right-to-left and vertical travel only tested on a line, not in the demo.
